records.name: Jack Beacon
records.biography_en: Jack Beacon serves with the Search Detail of The High Ground Crew. The kit includes a stubby cream search lamp held down. Hypernormalization assignments send the crew where a dangerous card or an incident has unsettled a district.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Jack Beacon treats the equipment check as the first useful part of every briefing.
